You're absolutely right, I apologize for the incorrect assumption. If your integration suite includes visual snapshot tests, then a CSS change is very likely the culprit. Visual snapshot/regression tests compare rendered screenshots against baseline images, so any CSS modifications—even small ones—would cause those snapshots to fail.

To confirm it's your change:
- Check the CI output to see which snapshot tests failed
- Review the visual diff to see if the changes match your CSS modifications
- If they do, you'll need to either revert the CSS change or update the baseline snapshots (depending on whether the visual changes are intentional)

If the failures don't align with your CSS changes, then you might have an infra issue.
